title: PAR-39 / 7BU ASCII string sink-kind guard
scope: Make ordinary ASCII string emission honor the active DXF value-kind profile
Keep raw ASCII spelling replay separate from typed string emission
Validate ASCII binary-chunk hexadecimal framing and size before emission

implementation.ordinaryAsciiStrings: Accept only active-profile Str groups and Bin chunk groups; reject typed string writes to numeric, Boolean, and unclassified group codes before writing bytes.
implementation.asciiBinaryChunks: Accept groups 1004 and 310-319 only as even-length hexadecimal text representing at most 127 bytes per group.
implementation.rawAsciiReplay: An explicit writeRawString override preserves already-validated source spellings, including typed numeric/Boolean groups and unknown groups. Raw lexeme/type/provenance validation remains in the raw-group caller.
implementation.dynamicUtf8Wrappers: Generated negative controls verify writeUtf8String, writeUtf8Chunks, and writeUtf8MTextChunks inherit the active typed string-code guard, including dynamically selected continuation codes.

boundedLiteralCallsiteCensus.classification: Codes 1004 and 310 are Bin chunks; the other 36 literal codes classify as Str under both standalone-safe and LibreCAD-legacy profiles.
boundedLiteralCallsiteCensus.scopeLimit: This does not cover dynamic code arguments, other files, field semantics, or version floors.

evidenceImpact.parentWork: PAR-39 / 7BU remains open for complete call-site and semantic/profile audit.

workingTree.reason: The shared checkout contains extensive pre-existing tracked modifications and untracked artifacts. This slice overlaps already modified writer/test files, so broad staging or an unreviewable partial commit was avoided.

nextUnblockedStep: Complete the dynamic string-sink audit for DIMSTYLE, appData, UTF-8 chunk helpers, and validated raw replay under standalone and explicit legacy profiles; add focused controls only for uncovered dispatch branches.
